Name: (CR) Kisaa's Secret Grove Farm
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][size=3]﻿﻿Welcome to the [b]Secret Grove Farm:[/b] A flowery little farm in the woods... who knows what you might find in here?

[/size][size=3][i]Major Update in v.1.1.0: [/i]The farm is actually flowery now. Adds flowering wall vines from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]my tilesheets[/url]﻿ (now added as a requirement!).[/size][/center]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Farm added through AdditionalFarms: [/b]Does NOT replace any Vanilla farms and is selectable from the farm type menu on starting a new save.
[*][b]Puzzle elements: [/b]Solve to uncover and access all features in the map (toggleable, but recommended for a first try).
[*][b]Custom starter giftbox items: [/b]Choose before starting a new save!
[*][b]Diggable grass tiles: [/b]There are designated crop plots prepared, but feel free to dig in anywhere!
[*][b]Custom fish/crab pot catch pool: [/b]Fish for river fish in the rivers, and more...
[*][b]Forest forage and respawning hardwood stumps: [/b]If you don't want this, [i][b]delete the [FTM] CR Secret Grove Farm folder.[/b][/i]
[*][b]Custom farm cave (toggleable) and starter farmhouse layout[/b]
[*][b]Supports 2-person multiplayer![/b]
[*][b]Farm customization[/b]
[/list]
[size=3]Want to adjust these features to your liking? You can do it all in the mod config! Install [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3] for easier in-game customization.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img]

This mod contains several puzzle gameplay elements. Some are tied to general progression. These features are all optional (see Config Options section below), but is recommended for your first playthrough of this map (and because I've put in quite a bit of work into them! ;))

[b][i][size=3]Spoilers for some of the features below:[/size]
[/i][/b]
[spoiler]The hot springs in the farm cave is fully functional. Change into swimsuit by walking behind the bush indicated in this image, and jump into the hot springs from the wood bridge.

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/FbN80s9/SG-Springs.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Starter Gift: [/b]Changes stuff you get from the starter gift box.
[*][b]Available options:[/b] Farmer (15x Parsnip Seeds), Florist (15x Tulip Bulbs, 2x Bee House).
[*][b]Custom Farm Cave: [/b]Enables custom farm cave. [b][i]Set to false if using other modded farm caves. Disabling this will disable all puzzle elements.[/i][/b]
[*][b]Secrets: [/b]Toggles puzzles and secrets in the map. [b][i]Set this to false and "Custom Farm Cave" to true if you want to use only the custom farm cave.[/i][/b]
[*][b]More Grassy Tiles: [/b]Adds more grass terrain instead of dirt in the farm map.
[*][b]More Flowers: [/b]Adds some more flowers in the farm. [i]Slightly [/i]reduces amount of buildable tiles.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, etc.
[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with recolor mods: Vibrant Pastoral, Earthy, Starblue, Eemie.
[b][u]Not Compatible[/u] [/b]with mods that replace FarmCave.tmx (unless Custom Farm Cave is set to false).

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736/]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿.
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Secret Grove Farm" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Do not install this mod on an existing save file, as it will result in wrong debris/object/building spawns.
[*]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer. Feel free to and report any multiplayer-related issues back to me.
[/list]
[size=3]As usual please report any bugs here on Nexus, or you can reach out to me (crystalinerose) in the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord[/url]﻿ for a faster response.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Thank you to the patient folks in the modding channels for helping me during the creation of this mod!

[/list][/b]
